overclaims: e2 explanation: "The reviewers identified practical writing strengths, cautioning against treating coding results as the whole product." The Every text praises the writing, but it never cautions against judging the model on coding results. It also says competitors "outscore GPT-4.5 in multiple benchmarks," so this sentence misdescribes the source.
checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim. Reading "moat" as OpenAI's moat is reasonable, and the case flags that ambiguity. The rationale's dates and figures (45% vs Sonnet 3.7/DeepSeek V3, the Sep 2026 update, 400M weekly users and 2M enterprise users on Feb 20) match e1–e3. Axis, horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. The citation fields are correct. The case fails only because the e2 explanation says the reviewers cautioned against treating coding results as the whole product, which the source does not say.
